about: The final frontier beckons for aid. Join the Neon strike team in their battle against tyranny.
• Hold out for as long as possible against a seemingly endless threat.
• Aim to achieve the highest possible score. It will be converted to Currency at the end of each run.
• Use the acquired Currency to upgrade Damage, Health and Speed.
• Pay attention to the heat meter. If your weapon overheats, it will leave you defenseless for a short while.
Enhanced game play on PS4 Pro console
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
